summary_en: Airbag / seatbelt pretensioner fault lights need a qualified technician with proper tools — do not deep-DIY SRS connectors or clock-spring work.
owner_prep_en: Note which lights are on, when they appeared, and any recent collision or battery work. Do not clear SRS codes as a fix.

summary_en: Opening brake hydraulic lines, DIY bleeding, or deep ABS module work is stop-DIY — use a qualified shop. Soft/spongy pedal or brake warning light → do not drive; tow / pro inspection. Observe-only: cold reservoir sight level, warning lights, recent pad work.
owner_prep_en: Record ABS/brake warning behavior, soft-pedal vs firm, cold reservoir sight level if visible, and any recent pad/rotor/fluid work. Do not open lines or bleed at home.

summary_en: Never open a pressurized hot cooling system. Stop DIY until fully cool; overheating with steam → safe pull-over / tow — not under-hood heroics or limping on the highway.
owner_prep_en: Note temperature gauge behavior and any coolant smell/steam after cool-down only. Do not keep driving with steam.

summary_en: Do not teach dangerous jump-pack placement near SRS/airbag lines or boil-out sulfation DIY. Prefer a qualified tech for deep electrical work.
owner_prep_en: Note no-crank vs slow-crank vs clicks, whether lights dim, and any recent battery work.

summary_en: Hybrid/EV high-voltage (orange) systems — stop DIY. Only trained HV technicians.
owner_prep_en: Record warning messages and whether the vehicle still drives normally; do not probe orange cabling.

summary_en: Adaptive/matrix headlight coding and OEM-level aiming require dealer/shop tools — do not give coding step-by-steps.
owner_prep_en: Note trim/package, which side failed, and whether ADAS camera sits on/near the lamp. Arrange professional aiming after any assembly swap.

summary_en: Headlamp work that disturbs ADAS camera brackets needs professional aim/calibration — prefer shop for assembly R&R if inexperienced.
owner_prep_en: Photo the camera/bracket area if safe; list driver-assist features that were active.
